diagnosis.cause: The app's MongoDB driver uses legacy opcodes that MongoDB 6 and later removed ("Unsupported OP_QUERY command"), so it connects but every write fails. The docs don't say which MongoDB to run; the driver needs 4.4 or older.

doc.text: MongoDB 4.4 (this project's driver can't talk to MongoDB 6+): docker run -d -p 27017:27017 mongo:4.4
